title: 第9章 史莱克学院第10章 故人重逢
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
索托城——
城中人来人往，宁荣荣东看看西看看买了不少东西：“唔，苒苒，你说的史莱克学院在索托城里吗？”
“不是。”
宁苒苒摇头：“在南边方向。”
一个小时后——
宁荣荣看着一座破败的学院嘴角抽了抽：“宁—苒—苒！
这就是你说的很厉害的学院！
？”
木头做的拱门上，一块写着’史莱克学院’五个大字的牌匾歪七扭八的挂在上面。
“额……”
宁苒苒知道学院会很破但是万万没想到会这么破！
这也太敷衍了吧！
要不是宁苒苒读过原着有外挂，光从这学院的外观上看，实在很难相信这所学院卧虎藏龙啊！
学院门口，一个长着鹰钩鼻，戴着黑柜水晶眼镜的五十多岁中年人躺在躺椅上，桌前一条长长的队伍，他闭着眼晃晃悠悠的说：“入学先交10个金魂币的报名费，测试不通过概不退换！”
是四眼猫鹰弗兰德！
在队伍的最后是一个身着黑色皮衣，身材火辣的女孩子，看着和她们同龄，黑色长发绑着高马尾。
宁苒苒眼睛一亮，是朱竹清！
然后她就拉着宁荣荣跑过去排队，“嗨！
你好！
我叫宁苒苒！”

宁苒苒拍了拍朱竹清的肩膀，言笑晏晏。
宁荣荣诧异，不明白宁苒苒为什么会对一个素不相识的女孩子这么热情！
但她还是冲朱竹清温柔的笑了笑。
宁苒苒：“这是我姐姐宁荣荣！”
朱竹清惊讶的点点头，面上不动声色：“朱竹清。”
她言简意赅，一如既往的冷漠。
这时前方突然传来吵闹声，“你们这分明就是在骗钱，退我们的报名费！
不然我们就不走了！
早知道史莱克学院是这样，我们就不来了！”
大家望去，一个少年的父亲瞪着弗兰德，狠狠的拍着桌子。
弗兰德懒懒的说：“我说过了，报名费概不退换。”
说完转头喊道：“沐白！”
那是一个高大少年，身高在一米八左右，肩宽腿长，英俊的相貌中带着几分刚毅，自带风流，满身邪气。
一头金色长发披散，直垂中腰，眼睛邪异，眸生双瞳，红蓝双色，目光中有一种发自内心深处的冰冷，半开阖之间邪光闪烁。
content_en:
Soto City——
People were coming and going in the city. Ning Rongrong looked around and bought a lot of things: "Well, Ranran, is the Shrek Academy you mentioned in Soto City?"
"No."
Ning Ranran shook her head: "In the south direction."
An hour later——
Ning Rongrong looked at a dilapidated college and her lips twitched: "Ning-ran-ran!
This is the awesome college you mentioned!
? "
On the wooden arch, a plaque with the words 'Shrek Academy' written in five characters hung crookedly on it.
"Um..."
Ning Ranran knew that the college would be very bad, but she never expected it to be so bad!
This is too perfunctory!
If Ning Ranran had not read the original book and had plug-ins, it would be hard to believe that this academy is Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon just from the appearance of it!
At the entrance of the college, a middle-aged man in his fifties with a hooked nose and black crystal glasses was lying on a recliner. There was a long line in front of the table. He closed his eyes and said swaying: "You must pay the registration fee of 10 gold soul coins before enrolling. There will be no refunds if you fail the test!"
It's Flanders, the four-eyed owl!
At the end of the team was a girl with a hot figure wearing a black leather jacket. She looked to be the same age as them, with long black hair tied into a high ponytail.
Ning Ranran's eyes lit up, it was Zhu Zhuqing!
Then she pulled Ning Rongrong and ran over to line up, "Hi!
Hello!
My name is Ning Ranran! "
Ning Ranran patted Zhu Zhuqing on the shoulder and smiled.
Ning Rongrong was surprised and didn't understand why Ning Ranran was so enthusiastic about a girl she had never met before!
But she still smiled gently at Zhu Zhuqing.
Ning Ranran: "This is my sister Ning Rongrong!"
Zhu Zhuqing nodded in surprise, his face expressionless: "Zhu Zhuqing."
She was concise and to the point, as cold as ever.
At this time, there was a sudden noise from the front, "You are obviously cheating us, refund our registration fee!
Otherwise we won't leave!
If we had known that Shrek Academy was like this, we wouldn't have come! "
Everyone looked around and saw the father of a young man glaring at Flanders and slamming the table hard.
Flanders said lazily: "I told you, the registration fee is non-refundable."
After speaking, he turned around and shouted: "Mubai!"
He was a tall young man, about 1.8 meters tall, with broad shoulders and long legs. His handsome appearance was somewhat resolute, and he was romantic and full of evil spirits.
He has long golden hair that hangs down to his waist, and his eyes are evil, with double pupils, red and blue. There is a kind of coldness coming from the depths of his heart in his eyes, and evil light flickers between half opening and closing.
